findings.title: Cached PhysicsServer shape can authorize movement at a different current Node transform
findings.closed_part: Original byteexact far-source/far-prop geometry8 now8/8; explicit LOS obstruction also stops safely.
findings.remaining: Unforced propNode+16Y: direct Shape2D.collide currentNodeFALSE,Nodebody(308,256)/shape(308,250),PhysicsServerbody(308,240)/shape(308,234),DirectSpaceState/runtime_nearfootTRUE. AfterCore SAMEtick propNode(308.700012,256) andactor+.700012,job1.
findings.control: Calling force_update_transform in QA callback updates PhysicsServerto256, directcollide/space/runtimefootFALSE; Corethenmoves0/job0. This control qualifies the missing production transform consistency; addingforceonlytoQA is not a fix.
findings.remediation: Production must check actual current Node collision geometry consistently with its movement source; sync/validate current object transforms before spatial query or use direct current-shape narrow phase. Preserve existing full eligibility and fail-closed guards.

findings.title: Old job cancellation can cancel a new same-kind action after reset reuses numeric attack id
findings.actual: Callback calls normal combat.reset()+player.reset(currentposition)+use_ability(), no manual cooldown override. Oldepoch6/id1; immediate newepoch7/id1, actionstartedTRUE/job1. AfterCore actionempty/id0/jobs0; replacement incorrectly canceled.
findings.cause: CombatSystem.reset clears next_attack_id=0. _stop_job compares only current authorized source+numericid, omits encounter epoch/action identity.
findings.positive_control: Previous extended callback cancelF→newshove is preserved correctly, so different-kind control alone was insufficient.
findings.remediation: Cancel only the exact old action/reservation, qualified by its encounter epoch and current authority/id (or equivalently strong unique identity); preserve replacement action/new job even when numeric ids repeat.
